summary: Familiar names, real surprises and a superb Blitz, but the source's partial totals put Mario at #42 and Hello Kitty at #11, so the classic game charges lives for answers players are right to expect. Free play until Wikipedia's figures are completed.
reasons: Casual found 7 before lives ran out: Star Wars, Marvel, Harry Potter, Pokemon, Mickey Mouse, Barbie, and Disney Princess offered by 'disney'. Fan found 8. Every natural spelling of the top 10 works, and all 24 casual Blitz names scored.

The source page is flagged out of date and its totals are partial sums. Mario counts only games up to 2002 ($9.74B, #42, below James Bond) and Hello Kitty adds 13 scattered years ($33.5B, #11). Both players lost a life on each.

Famous film franchises burn lives despite the 'not just films' hint: James Bond #41, Lord of the Rings #47, Avengers #28 apart from the MCU. Batman, Spider-Man and Transformers at #12-14 are fair near misses.
fixes: The Phantom of the Opera (#66) has the alias 'Hannibal', the opera inside the show and not a name of it: 'hannibal' (the Lecter franchise) costs a life as Phantom. Add it to junkAliases.
'sanrio' costs a life as the unranked Sanrio Boys through a word match, though a player typing it means Hello Kitty. Add 'Sanrio' as an alias of Hello Kitty (#11), or drop Sanrio Boys from the pool.
#2 Mickey Mouse & Friends has no reveal fact.
